text: Refined scope from feedback: (1) blocked by Phase 1b which generalizes as_image_matrix() -> as_subject_matrix(); Phase 1 factory rewrites consume that. (2) Use design-facing factory names: null_one_sample, null_two_sample, null_glm; null_subject_signflip becomes a thin alias of null_one_sample (the design names the factory; mechanism is implementation detail). (3) Consolidate the duplicate signflip factories: keep the deterministic-by-index variant (precomputed n_perm x n_subj sign matrix indexed by b) — that contract is correct for null_spec$draw(b). Retire the lazy variant (samples signs each call, no n_perm). (4) Two-sample contrast: default level 2 minus level 1; expose levels= and contrast= for explicit control.
